Ven. Sister Mary Dianne. 13200 Oak Park 31ve, Oak Park, Mich.
God bless you Ven. Sister Mary Dianne. God bless you and yours these unsettled days - as our beautiful diosesian Prayer for Peace notes - days of stress and trial. Indeed they are days at once of threatening forebodings and - not only days but decades too abounding in outstanding manifestions of God's merciful Goodness and Power and infinite Wisdom and
